messages:
mira: quick follow-up from today's all-hands Q&A about promotions/comp. two things: 1) are promotion effective dates always quarter boundaries? 2) what's the retro pay policy if approval comes after payroll runs?

sara (people ops): short answers: not always quarter boundaries. effective date is typically the first payroll date after calibration approval. retro pay is possible but capped. details below.

vp-people: +1 to sara. we avoid long backdating because of budget and equity vesting complexity. standard flow: approved effective_date -> payroll issues a single retro payment up to 30 days. exceptions need exec sign-off.

alex (eng mgr): missed the slide in the all-hands  (lol). is there a hard deadline for managers to upload promotion packets for this cycle?

people-ops-bot: Reminder: Manager packet submission window for this cycle: 2026-04-01 09:00 UTC to 2026-04-10 17:00 UTC. Late uploads are routed to next cycle unless exception granted.

sara (people ops): correct. upload window closes 2026-04-10 17:00 UTC. calibration meeting is 2026-04-17. late packets: file a late-case form; requires VP+ approval and may not get retro pay.

jamal: one more - spot bonuses vs promos. team member had a very strong review but manager put forward a small spot bonus instead of level up. is that normal?

vp-people: spot bonuses are for one-off contributions. promotions should reflect sustained increase in scope/impact. during calibration we flag borderline cases and recommend the right lever considering comp budget and leveling bar.

mira: appeals: what's the process if someone disagrees with calibration outcome? timeline?

sara (people ops): appeals flow: 1) discuss with manager within 5 business days of notification. 2) if unresolved, submit appeal form within 10 business days. 3) appeals panel (3 leaders) reviews within 15 business days. outcomes: uphold / partial / full. final communicated via manager.

alex (eng mgr): can managers access anonymized calibration notes or examples to coach folks?

people-ops-bot: People Ops update: anonymized calibration guidance and sample write-ups will be published to Confluence at /people-ops/calibration-guides by 2026-04-20.

jamal: comp bands - any changes this cycle? engineers ask if band shifts mean auto adjustments.

vp-people: bands reviewed annually. if bands change we run a mapping exercise and prioritize adjustments for those below new minima. not an automatic across-the-board uplift. budget constraints apply.

mira: can you post a compact FAQ + timeline for managers to reference in 1:1s? would be super helpful. :raising_hand:

sara (people ops): yes - I'll post a one-pager + FAQ in #people-ops today and ping managers. will include: timeline, retro-pay policy, upload window, appeals link, and exceptions contact. :white_check_mark:

vp-people: thanks everyone. if there are edge cases (equity cliff, active offers, relocation) DM me or file an exceptions ticket and we'll triage. :handshake:
